description: This file defines the 'Login' controller class within the OpenCart admin startup namespace. It handles requests related to user login verification, including checking user authentication status, route validation, and token validation. The primary function is the 'index' method that determines whether to allow access or redirect to the login page.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the login process within the admin startup flow in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the login route, verifies user authentication, route validity, and user token validity, returning actions or null based on checks.
